origins.section: The Same Seed Gives the Same Portfolio, in This Process and in a Fresh One
One Shared Stream Ties Every Draw to Every Draw Before It
Invariants State What Every Portfolio Must Satisfy, and a Test Checks Them at Many Seeds

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-version-pin: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-version-pin: 'guarantees that random() keeps producing the same sequence ... across Python versions; it makes no such promise for ... randint, choice, shuffle'.
recorded.prompt:q-new-draw: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-new-draw: 'adding one draw anywhere shifts every number after it, and every project generated after that point changes.' The crew draw takes the number the first project's start used, and everything after shifts.
recorded.prompt:q-more-seeds: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-more-seeds: A test at one seed checks one portfolio; a test at many seeds (the module's tests use three for large, and the program ten) is what makes "the generator never does this" believable.

gates.says: all 9 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-version-pin:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-version-pin:a: The same seed gives the same portfolio 'in this process and in processes that hash strings differently'; fresh interpreter: True.
recorded.prompt:q-version-pin:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-version-pin:c: Fresh interpreters with PYTHONHASHSEED=1 and =2 gave equal hashes. PYTHONHASHSEED salts string hashing, which does not touch an integer-seeded stream. This is shown for GridCap's generator, not stated for random.Random in general.
recorded.prompt:q-version-pin:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-version-pin:d: Helpers' 'algorithms may change'; only random() is promised to repeat across versions.
recorded.prompt:q-new-draw:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-new-draw:a: With one shared stream, 'every project after it changed: different kinds, costs and starts'.
recorded.prompt:q-new-draw:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-new-draw:b: The new draw 'shifts every number after it', so later kind, cost and start values change, not just the crew sizes.
recorded.prompt:q-new-draw:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-new-draw:d: Draws take 'the next number from the stream', and every later project changes, not just the last one.
recorded.prompt:q-more-seeds:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-more-seeds:b: Because they check them at the default seed only, and on tiny, small and medium: the large portfolio and every other seed were never checked. An invariant is a claim about *every* seed.
recorded.prompt:q-more-seeds:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-more-seeds:c: The same seed gives the same 10,000 projects in this process and in processes that hash strings
recorded.prompt:q-more-seeds:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-more-seeds:d: the plant shows that a check can fail, not that other seeds pass it, and only the checks at other seeds show that.
